title: Asking for a place or a city is simpler
items: Under Add a menu, type the place or the city and tap Send. It goes in a message to whoever shared the app with you, and they add it.
Nothing about GitHub or keys shows unless you open I'm the app's owner at the bottom.

title: Ask for a city
items: A city not in the app? Ask for it at the bottom of the UK cities or Abroad list, or under Add a menu.
Its places are found through coeliac guides and each one is checked against its own website where it has one, then added once the app's owner approves. You'll get a notification when it's in.
Every city in the app is now re-checked each month, so a place that has closed or changed what it says comes off the list sooner.

title: Less clutter: the food comes first
items: A restaurant's page now opens on its menu: the tips and warnings are one line above it, a tap away.
The switch at the top reads Chains, UK cities and Abroad. A city's buttons are fewer, with the German or Dutch card first abroad.
Opening hours with a lunch break read clearly, and the order builder, Near me and the counts are tidier.

title: UK cities: London, York, Sheffield, Poole and Worksop
items: A new switch at the top: UK franchises for the chains' menus, UK cities, and International for Berlin and Amsterdam. The title under it chooses the restaurant or city.

18 places in London, York, Sheffield, Poole and near Worksop, found through coeliac guides and checked against their own websites where they have one. Each is tagged with who calls it gluten free, and oats, beer and wheat starch are flagged.
Each UK city also lists the app's chains with branches there, with their menus one tap away.

title: The map and Near me now work instantly, even without signal
items: The chains' branches now come with the app, refreshed every week, so the map and Near me answer at once and work offline.
Your position no longer leaves your phone: what's near you is worked out on the phone itself.
On the map, zoom in to a town to see the chains' branches there.

title: A map of everywhere you can eat
items: Tap the globe next to the restaurant name for a map with your position, which follows you as you move.
Pins show the chains' branches around you and every place on the Abroad lists, in their list colours.
Tap a pin for the distance, today's hours and directions, then Menu for the chain's menu or Open for the place's own words.
